scripts.still: bun build.ts && slopcamera html still --input out/scene.json --at 2.5,7,11,15.5,20,24.5,30,34.5,39.5 --output out/stills
scripts.still:portrait: bun build.ts --aspect 9:16 && slopcamera html still --input out/scene.json --at 2.5,7,11,15.5,20,24.5,30,34.5,39.5 --output out/stills-portrait
scripts.render: bun build.ts && slopcamera html render --input out/scene.json --json > out/export.json
scripts.deliver: slopcamera html deliver out/export.json --basename soulscrape-launch --poster-at 15.5 --social-at 24.5 --cuts 1:1 --per-beat-clips --beats out/beats.json --output out/deliver
